text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A private event reserved for the academy was held at Bubbly Land, so while participating as staff—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yup, body feels light! That massage Miracle taught me is working wonders!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And Ace-san pumped fighting spirit into me too! Full of energy! Gonna enjoy this to the absolute fullest~♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
HYUUU~~!!
TURBO HYPEDDDDD☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
So, one more run?
Let's blast it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAAAAAASH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! The absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Man, legit fast. Way faster than running, no cap.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right on☆ Should we tell Prezzy-poo? That we want a giant slide!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And install it on the uphill slope? Haha, that's totally going backwards, but sounds fun♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, talking about training, are we? That dedication is admirable!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This is a special academy-reserved invite event, remember! Make sure to enjoy yourselves with proper moderation!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
Gotcha☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's keep it up with nicely behaved vibes~! Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haa... slid so much... slid my soul out... Can we go take a tea break?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll take a break too.
What are you guys gonna do, Palmer-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go for a bit more! Helios too—looks like she's still totally ready to rumble, see!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Way-way-waaaaaay☆
Foooooooo~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fuu~~! Awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fuu~~...
Awe, some............pien.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoops, is my little sun finally getting tuckered out?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... so beat...
Wait, how's Palm-chin still so hyped...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I can still keep going!
Super energized!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real...?! How come????
Aren't you crazy cracked????

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's because—
I prepped with everything I had just for today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We've got both training and classes, so every day is super tough, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But don't you want time spent with friends to be the absolute best it can be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So I got people around me to help out—and saved up my stamina by pacing myself in all sorts of ways! All so I could have fun at full blast♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Man, she really is so cool.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, what... huh?! If you say it like that, of course I'm gonna wanna live it up too...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
~~~!! Let's go, let's gooo!!
The sun is revived☆ Time to tear it up~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's slide all out until the very end~~!!

text_block_list.name: 4 Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHTTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Looks like everyone had a thoroughly fulfilling time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Facts☆
All thanks to the MVP, Palm-chin!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Palmer-san's self-management skills are something I need to learn from too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Eh?! It's really not that big of a deal, but... fufu, hearing you say that makes me really happy♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm exhausted, but that was fun.
It's been a while since I had a day off like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Body's wrecked though... super heavy.
Isn't tomorrow gonna be brutal at this rate?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's where self-management comes in! Head straight to bed once we're home, and keep tomorrow's training light! How's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, that early-to-bed, early-to-rise stuff...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Rough... but yeah, gotta do it.
We've gotta work on self-management too.
